name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - § 2, point c, premier tiret - Am 8
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: – limit reductions and increases in the number of fishing days to maximum 20 %, where possible and subject to the best available scientific advice, while taking account of fleet-segment-specific profitability thresholds;
